name: v27-33-v3-postprocessor
objective: v2.7 33 W1 V3 (post-processor leg live, floor: the next request carries the settled text in every burst case, x2). NOT RUN (recorded 2026-10-07: written and validated statically, no live lane). Reference post-processor: one transform, SO-V3 typographic quotes (test/fixtures/postprocessor/so-v3-typographic-quotes.regex.json), in two placements. Regex leg: the stock Regex script (global, AI output, alters the chat) is applied by ST inside cleanUpMessage before saveReply, so the reply is already rewritten at MESSAGE_RECEIVED; asserted: every reply generated while it is installed carries no straight-quoted span and the edit re-read saw no edit. Post-render legs (test/fixtures/postprocessor/so-v3-postprocessor.js, Recast-shaped: after the round and after the story committed the reply, chat[id].mes rewritten, updateMessageBlock, MESSAGE_EDITED unawaited, saveChat): single, double (Recast's two safeUpdateMessageText calls) and late (a second rewrite 1500 ms after the first, past the 750 ms settle window, the V0 defect shape). Each rewrite appends a sentence that satisfies the next gate; the request the next send posts must carry only the next checkpoint's marker and the settled text, with no hold timeout. Run twice on a model lane with the dev build: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-33-v3-postprocessor.json --sandbox (requires.group pins the toy group by name). Manual equivalent: node scripts/debug/so-postprocessor.mts install --post-render --burst late --append "...".

requires.why: real replies on the main profile and real reads on the read role; the post-processor is scripted in the page, the spike flag spikes.editReread is switched on and restored by the scenario

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const v3 = globalThis.__v3; globalThis.__soPostProcessor?.disarm(); const removed = globalThis.__soPostProcessor?.removeRegex('SO-V3') ?? { removed: [] }; if (v3?.onSent) ctx.eventSource.removeListener(ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA, v3.onSent); const settings = ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']?.settings; if (settings && v3) { if (v3.before) settings.spikes = v3.before; else delete settings.spikes; } await (await import('/script.js')).saveSettings(); return { restored: v3?.before ?? null, removed };
